reason: A DSH Web UI plugin that sends contextual desktop browser notifications for approvals, questions, interruptions, errors, and completed turns, with click-through navigation to the related session.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供桌面浏览器通知，在需要审批、回答问题或回合完成时提醒用户，并支持点击通知返回相关会话。
summaries.en: Adds desktop browser notifications to the DSH Web UI for approvals, questions, and turn completion, with click-through navigation to the related session.

capabilities: Displays browser desktop notifications for approvals, questions, and completed turns
Navigates to the related DSH session when a notification is clicked
